steps.whatIf:
class EntityState:
    TRANSIENT = "TRANSIENT"
    PENDING = "PENDING"
    PERSISTENT = "PERSISTENT"

class SynthesizedUnitOfWork:
    def __init__(self):
        self.identity_map = {}
        self.pending = []
        self.db = {}

    def add(self, entity):
        entity.state = EntityState.PENDING
        self.pending.append(entity)

    def commit(self):
        flushed = 0
        for entity in self.pending:
            self.db[entity.id] = entity
            entity.state = EntityState.PERSISTENT
            self.identity_map[entity.id] = entity
            flushed += 1
        self.pending.clear()
        return flushed

class AccountRecord:
    def __init__(self, id, balance):
        self.id = id
        self.balance = balance
        self.state = EntityState.TRANSIENT

uow = SynthesizedUnitOfWork()
a1 = AccountRecord(101, 5000)
a2 = AccountRecord(102, 12000)
uow.add(a1)
uow.add(a2)
print("Before commit: pending =", len(uow.pending), "| state =", a1.state)
flushed = uow.commit()
print(f"Committed {flushed} entities. IdentityMap size: {len(uow.identity_map)}, state = {a1.state}")
uow.dirty_changes = {a1.id: {"balance": 5500}}
updates = [f"UPDATE accounts SET {col}={val} WHERE id={aid}" for aid, cols in uow.dirty_changes.items() for col, val in cols.items()]
print(f"Minimal Dirty SQL: {updates[0]}")
